digest.component_or_area: documentation and ADR for S3 ticket-store backend
propositions: Documentation must explain that sync.remote accepts s3://bucket/prefix remotes served by the optional git-remote-s3 helper and link to the new backend guide.

A new operator guide (docs/s3-backend.md) must cover dependency installation, SSE-KMS bucket and IAM/CMK setup, git remote configuration, AWS credentials and encryption trust boundary, and auto-doctor self-heal behavior for stale locks (60s TTL via GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS env var).

A new ADR (0093-s3-ticket-store-backend.md) must record the decision to use git-remote-s3, accept SSE-KMS encryption, implement merge-based auto-doctor, and reject TTL lowering, following existing ADR format.
The ADR index automation (gen_adr_index.py, check_adr_numbers.py) must produce marker file .numbers/0093 and regenerate README.md, with both ADR gates passing CI validation.
